'''Gorset''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Rhamalai]]. They roamed the plains of Rhamalai in herds of five to two hundred, and were easily domesticated. [[Denel Moonrunner]] had a gorset, [[Chaser (gorset)|Chaser]], as a pet. Gorset were used to provide power for Rhamalian farm equipment and as transport, and could carry 150 - 200 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].
